mc GEOGRAPHY revenue by region is not disclosed: one operating segment; 10-K/10-Q give no revenue or long-lived assets by country. Revenue is products (gateway equipment/software to MNOs) and services mainly from U.S. government (directly or via primes) [pf_10k_20260302, pf_10q_20260810]. Gap.

mc EXPOSURE Israel operations: ~1% of consolidated total assets and ~5% of operating expenses in 6M 2026; 10-Q says not materially impacted by Middle East conflict [pf_10q_20260810, mc_f_israel_assets, mc_f_israel_opex]. Sized, small.

mc EXPOSURE Tariffs: 10-Q says tariffs on supply chain products from several jurisdictions had no material impact to date; future increase could raise capital costs of satellites. Unsized (hypothesis) [pf_10q_20260810].

mc EXPOSURE Spectrum/FCC: service depends on FCC authorizations (FCC authorization for 248-satellite network incl. low-band IMT frequencies) and on Ligado spectrum usage rights, whose $550M SpectrumCo Sound Point delayed-draw facility is conditioned on FCC approvals and Ligado bankruptcy events, availability until 2026-10-05 with 180-day extension option for 1% fee; no drawdown as of 10-Q [pf_10q_20260810]. Status after 10-Q not confirmed (gap; the extension election is not in the filings list).

mc EXPOSURE International ops/suppliers: engineering centers in India, Scotland, Spain, Israel; about 418 of 1,126 employees outside U.S.; international suppliers; launch dependence on third-party vehicles (10-K risk factors) [pf_10k_20260302]. Launch-vehicle share not sized here (gap for gather_field).
mc EXPOSURE Export controls/ITAR: not found in the 10-K risk-factor grep as a sized item; unsized hypothesis only.
mc NEWS 2026-10-20 8-K Item 5.02: new 3-year employment agreement with CFO/CLO Andrew Johnson (base >= $250k, RSUs eligible); routine, not a departure [mc_8k_20261020].
mc NEWS 2026-09-28 8-K Item 5.02: Senior Management Change of Control Severance Policy adopted 2026-09-25 [mc_8k_20260928].
